ALTER PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_BNKM_UITFAUMBalance_TRU
AS
BEGIN

WITH TEMP_BNKM_UITFAUMBalance AS 
(
    SELECT
		BTA.ASOFDATE AS BalanceTimestamp
		,BTA.BASE_NO AS BaseAccountId
		,BTA.PORTFOLIO_NO AS CustomerAccountId
		,'TUTF' AS ProductId
		,BTA.CUSTOMER_NAME AS CustomerName
		,BTA.CUSTOMER_TYPE AS CustomerTypeId
		,BTA.BRANCH AS BranchId
		,BTA.CURRENCY AS IsoCurrencyCode
		,BTA.CUSTOMER_FUND_VALUE_IN_PHP AS BalanceAmount
		,BTA.TOTAL_FUND_VALUE_IN_PHP AS TotalBalanceAmount
		,'TRU' AS SourceSystemCode
		,BTA.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,BTA.insert_dttm AS InsertDttm
	FROM BUSC.TRU_AUMUITF BTA
	WHERE BTA.isLatest = 1
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_UITFAUMBalance FROM TEMP_BNKM_UITFAUMBalance;

INSERT INTO [BNKM].[UITFAUMBalance]
(
		BalanceTimestamp
		,BaseAccountId
		,CustomerAccountId
		,ProductId
		,CustomerName
		,CustomerTypeId
		,BranchId
		,IsoCurrencyCode
		,BalanceAmount
		,TotalBalanceAmount
		,SourceSystemCode
		,FinancialInstitutionId
		,WorkFlowId
		,TaskRunId
		,InsertDttm)
SELECT
		BalanceTimestamp
		,BaseAccountId
		,CustomerAccountId
		,ProductId
		,CustomerName
		,CustomerTypeId
		,BranchId
		,IsoCurrencyCode
		,BalanceAmount
		,TotalBalanceAmount
		,SourceSystemCode
		,FinancialInstitutionId
		,WorkFlowId
		,TaskRunId
		,InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_UITFAUMBalance


END
